description: Reads one entity property. Populates only the output for that property.
examples: Provides the entity property family contract for entity workflows.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Entity whose selected property is read.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Get returns the property value. Has checks whether it is present.

inputs.name: property
inputs.description: Supported entity-data property name. Its type and allowed actions depend on the target entity kind.

outputs.name: has
outputs.description: True when Has finds a non-null value for the selected property. A Boolean false still counts as a present value.

outputs.name: name
outputs.description: Entity name reported by the server, including a custom name when present.

outputs.name: custom_name
outputs.description: Custom name assigned to the entity, or no value when unset.

outputs.name: glowing
outputs.description: Whether the entity has the glowing outline effect.

outputs.name: silent
outputs.description: Whether the entity's normal sounds are suppressed.

outputs.name: invulnerable
outputs.description: Whether the entity has invulnerability enabled.

outputs.name: fire_ticks
outputs.description: Remaining burning time in server ticks.

outputs.name: freeze_ticks
outputs.description: Freezing progress in server ticks.

outputs.name: health
outputs.description: Current health in health points. Two points equal one heart. Requires a living entity.

outputs.name: max_health
outputs.description: Effective maximum health in health points, including attribute modifiers. Requires a living entity.

outputs.name: persistent
outputs.description: Whether the mob is marked to persist.

outputs.name: target
outputs.description: Living entity currently targeted by the mob, or no value when it has no target.

outputs.name: baby
outputs.description: Whether an ageable entity is a baby.

outputs.name: tamed
outputs.description: Whether a tameable entity has been tamed.

outputs.name: sitting
outputs.description: Whether an entity that supports sitting is seated.

outputs.name: swimming
outputs.description: Whether a living entity is in the swimming pose.

outputs.name: pickup_items
outputs.description: Whether a living entity is allowed to pick up nearby items.

outputs.name: gravity
outputs.description: Whether gravity affects the entity.

outputs.name: visible
outputs.description: Visibility property for entity kinds that support it.

outputs.name: ai
outputs.description: Whether the living entity's normal AI is enabled.

outputs.name: collidable
outputs.description: Whether the living entity can collide with other entities.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: True when the entity is valid and not dead.

outputs.name: type
outputs.description: Minecraft entity type name, such as ZOMBIE.

outputs.name: uuid
outputs.description: Unique identifier of the entity.

outputs.name: location
outputs.description: World position, yaw, and pitch of the entity.

outputs.name: velocity
outputs.description: Motion vector of the entity in blocks per server tick.

outputs.name: world
outputs.description: Loaded world containing the entity.

outputs.name: passengers
outputs.description: Entities currently riding this entity.

outputs.name: vehicle
outputs.description: Entity this entity is riding, or no value when not mounted.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: Entity bounding-box height in blocks.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: Entity bounding-box width in blocks.

outputs.name: ticks_lived
outputs.description: Number of server ticks the entity has existed.

outputs.name: no_damage_ticks
outputs.description: Remaining damage-immunity time in server ticks.

outputs.name: remaining_air
outputs.description: Current air supply in server ticks.

outputs.name: max_air
outputs.description: Maximum air supply in server ticks.

outputs.name: fall_distance
outputs.description: Accumulated falling distance in blocks.

outputs.name: portal_cooldown
outputs.description: Remaining portal cooldown in server ticks.

outputs.name: scoreboard_tags
outputs.description: Scoreboard tag strings assigned to the entity.

outputs.name: absorption
outputs.description: Extra absorption health in health points. Two points equal one heart.

outputs.name: remove
outputs.description: Action that removes the entity from the world.

outputs.name: kill
outputs.description: Action that kills a living entity by reducing its health to zero.

outputs.name: is_alive
outputs.description: True when the entity is valid and not dead.

outputs.name: is_valid
outputs.description: True when the entity remains valid in its world.

outputs.name: is_dead
outputs.description: True when the entity is dead or no longer valid.

description: Changes one selected entity property or runs an entity action. The property determines its supported actions and the required Value type.
examples: Provides the entity property family contract for entity workflows.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the entity operation when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Entity to change or act on.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Set changes the property using Value. Do or Execute runs an action supported by that property.

inputs.name: property
inputs.description: Supported entity-data property name. Its type and allowed actions depend on the target entity kind.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: New value for Set, with the type and units required by the selected property.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues execution after the entity operation completes.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True after the selected entity action completes. Invalid values or unsupported properties fail execution.
